name: Tiagabine
metabolism: Thiophene-ring oxidation forms inactive 5-oxo-tiagabine, with glucuronidation also occurring. In-vitro evidence points mainly to CYP3A. Elimination is mainly fecal and urinary as metabolites.
summary: Tiagabine is an oral anticonvulsant used to treat epilepsy. It inhibits the GABA transporter GAT-1, reducing GABA reuptake.
